# Skips the gui-tests job expects on GitHub's macos-15 runner. Every other
# skip fails the job (Scripts/check_test_skips.py), because a skipped GUI test
# passes green without guarding anything. Each entry is pinned to its test and
# to the start of its skip reason; say why it cannot run on the runner.

# Needs the Simplified Chinese Pinyin input source, which the runner does not
# enable; the marked-text contract it exercises is tested headlessly.
MD2CoreTests.MarkdownEditingGUITests/testPinyinReturnCommitsLatinLettersWithoutContinuingList | Enable Simplified Chinese Pinyin

# A manual export tool: it runs only when a developer points it at a file.
MD2CoreTests.PDFExportEndToEndVerification/testExportProvidedMarkdownPath | Set MD2_VERIFY_PDF_SOURCE and MD2_VERIFY_PDF_OUTPUT

# Need the Pandoc binary, which the runner image does not include; they skip in
# build-test-package for the same reason (see PandocConverterTests).
MD2CoreTests.PandocConverterTests/testRealConversionDeletesPartialOutputOnFailure | Pandoc not installed.
MD2CoreTests.PandocConverterTests/testRealConversionEmbedsRelativeImage | Pandoc not installed.
MD2CoreTests.PandocConverterTests/testRealConversionProducesValidDocx | Pandoc not installed.
